subject: br: load necessary db infos for backup and restore (#64982)
summary: Introduces an optional `issyncer.Filter` (used by BR) to limit infoschema loading to system/BR-temporary and optionally specified DBs, backed by a new streaming `meta.Reader.IterDatabases`; default TiDB server behavior remains unchanged when the filter is nil. Reviewed loader full/diff load paths (including schema-version advancement on skipped diffs), meta iteration semantics, and domain/session plumbing; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata state handling within the touched infoschema/meta areas. Later upstream/master history shows no follow-up changes in these reviewed files suggesting a subsequent fix was needed.
